column1: test_gen_autogenesis_mathlib_stable_statement_comparison
column2: RED on 2026-08-27, diagnosed by lane red-drift, and NOT content drift: `verify_inputs()` in `scripts/gen-autogenesis-mathlib-stable-statement-comparison.py` runs `git -C /nas3/.../mathlib-v4.32.1-checkout rev-parse HEAD` and treats a nonzero exit the same as a commit mismatch. On this host that `git` call fails with "detected dubious ownership" (the NFS-shared checkout is owned by a different uid), NOT because HEAD moved -- `git -c safe.directory='*' -C <checkout> rev-parse HEAD` prints exactly the pinned `520045ab14e26149ee970e2e617ca04b09bde5d6`. The checker's subprocess call should pass `-c safe.directory=<path>` itself rather than depending on ambient git config (CLAUDE.md: never `git config --global` in a shared checkout). Fix belongs to whoever owns `scripts/gen-autogenesis-mathlib-stable-statement-comparison.py`.
